title: A brand-new card and Lightning Bolt
question: Can I respond to Nonexistent Test Card's triggered ability with Lightning Bolt?
shortAnswer: Yes. The trigger goes on the stack and you can respond ([[rule:603.3]]); [[card:Lightning Bolt]] resolves first ([[rule:608.1]]). [[card:Nonexistent Test Card]]'s own ruling says the ability still resolves if the creature leaves ([[ruling:nonexistent-test-card-1]]).

steps.text: **The trigger goes on the stack** ([[rule:603.3]]) above nothing; you get priority.
**Cast [[card:Lightning Bolt]]** targeting the creature. It goes on the stack above the trigger ([[rule:608.1]]).
**Resolve top-down**: Bolt kills the creature, then the trigger resolves anyway ([[ruling:nonexistent-test-card-1]]).
